Title: Azure Virtual Desktop web client to end support for Internet Explorer 11 on September 30, 2021

Body.Content:
Beginning September 30, 2021, the Azure Virtual Desktop web client will no longer support IE 11. This means starting September 30, 2021, customers will be unable to access the web client on IE 11. For more information, check out our Tech Community blog post. 

The recommended browser for the web client is Microsoft Edge, which follows the Modern Lifecycle Policy. You can download Microsoft Edge here.
